duplicate_row_check.name: Duplicate Row Check (ID)
duplicate_row_check.query: SELECT ID, COUNT(*) FROM default_of_credit GROUP BY ID HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

null_check_id.name: Null Check ID
null_check_id.query: SELECT * FROM default_of_credit WHERE ID IS NULL

null_check_limit_bal.name: Null Check Limit_Bal
null_check_limit_bal.query: SELECT * FROM default_of_credit WHERE LIMIT_BAL IS NULL

target_check_y.name: Target Variable Check
target_check_y.query: SELECT * FROM default_of_credit WHERE "default payment next month" NOT IN (0,1)
